summary: David testifies, The earth is the Lord’s and the fulness thereof, he who has clean hands and a pure heart will ascend unto the hill of the Lord, and the Lord of Hosts is the King of Glory.
meta_description: David testifies, The earth is the Lord’s and the fulness thereof, he who has clean hands and a pure heart will ascend unto the hill of the Lord, and the Lord of Hosts is the King of Glory.

footnotes.note1_a: Ex. 9:29; Deut. 10:14; Ps. 89:11; 1 Cor. 10:26. TG Nature, Earth.
